title: About Dream To Build
tagline: Dragging High Concept Pretty Pictures Kicking and Screaming into the Real World

content.mission: Dream To Build is a dedicated digital archive and technical workshop workspace. It documents the real-world engineering, custom fabrication, and conceptual blueprints behind pre-1975 custom restomods, hybrid powertrains, and space-frame designs.

pillars.heading: Active Shop Builds
pillars.description: Hands-on metal fabrication, chassis engineering, custom wiring, and precision powertrain assembly.

pillars.heading: Design & Blueprints
pillars.description: Calculated geometry, CAD layouts, suspension kinematics, and structural mockups.

pillars.heading: Pure Vision Concepts
pillars.description: High-concept automotive styling and unconstrained technical explorations.
